recognize_zh: 臉部（鼻樑、兩頰、上唇周圍）與手背等日曬處可見紅斑、細小線狀/凹陷性淺疤與皮膚粗厚，沒有水疱，符合紅血球生成性原紫質症（erythropoietic protoporphyria）慢性光敏感的皮膚變化。
features: Clinical photographs, not a microscopic image
Panel A: erythema over the nose and cheeks with fine linear and shallow pitted scars on the face and perioral skin
Panel B: dorsal hand with thickened, slightly waxy skin and small scattered crusts/scars over knuckles and fingers
describe_en: Clinical photographs (Balwani and Desnick, Hematology 2012) show the face with erythema over the nose and cheeks and fine linear and shallow pitted scars around the nose and upper lip, and the dorsal hand with thickened skin and small scattered crusts over sun-exposed areas. Bullae are not seen. These chronic changes follow repeated painful acute phototoxic reactions. Findings are consistent with erythropoietic protoporphyria; diagnosis is confirmed by markedly elevated erythrocyte free (metal-free) protoporphyrin.

ddx.vs: PCT shows vesicles, bullae, skin fragility and hypertrichosis with elevated urine uroporphyrin, whereas EPP lacks blisters and has normal urine porphyrins.
Clinical findings are identical; XLP has a higher proportion of zinc protoporphyrin and ALAS2 gain-of-function mutation.
PMLE produces delayed pruritic papules or plaques rather than immediate burning pain, and erythrocyte protoporphyrin is normal.
Hydroa vacciniforme forms vesicles that heal with varioliform scars and is associated with EBV, with normal protoporphyrin levels.
